Tooltip_OffGridArray: A proper tilted array. Point it south, keep it clear of roofs, sweep the snow off in winter.
Tooltip_OffGridArrayMono: Monocrystalline cells on an aluminium frame. Twice the array of the standard frame, and it barely notices the heat.
Tooltip_OffGridArraySalvage: Cannibalised cells on a scrap frame. Weak, and the weather eats it, but it is a panel and it is free.
Tooltip_OffGridBackupLectromax: A Lectromax generator converted for Off-Grid. It gives 4,000 W and only ever feeds the controller it is cabled to.
Tooltip_OffGridBackupOld: An old generator converted for Off-Grid. It gives 3,000 W and only ever feeds the controller it is cabled to.
Tooltip_OffGridBackupPremium: A Premium Technologies generator converted for Off-Grid. It gives 5,000 W and only ever feeds the controller it is cabled to.
Tooltip_OffGridBackupValuTech: A ValuTech generator converted for Off-Grid. It gives 2,500 W and only ever feeds the controller it is cabled to.
Tooltip_OffGridBank: An open steel rack for six car batteries. Running it flat costs capacity for good.
Tooltip_OffGridBankCrate: Three car batteries strapped to a pallet. Small, leaky, and it hates being run flat.
Tooltip_OffGridBankSealed: Eight sealed deep-cycle cells in a vented cabinet. Holds its charge in the cold and forgives a deep discharge.
Tooltip_OffGridController: Ties the arrays and the banks together and powers everything nearby. Silent, unlike a generator.
Tooltip_OffGridControllerMPPT: Tracks each array's maximum power point. Ten per cent more out of the same panels, and a better readout.
Tooltip_OffGridFlat: Lies almost flat, so it wins the summer and loses the winter. Snow sits on it until you climb up and sweep it.
Tooltip_OffGridFlatMono: The best cells on the lowest frame. Enormous in July, disappointing in January.
Tooltip_OffGridFlatSalvage: Salvaged cells on a low frame for a rooftop. Cheap, and out of reach of anything on the ground.
Tooltip_OffGridGardenLamp: A knee-high light with its own little panel and battery. It charges in the sun and lights the path from dusk to dawn. Needs no wiring.
Tooltip_OffGridStreetLamp: A street light on a pole, with its own panel and battery pack. It charges all day and lights the road from dusk to dawn. Needs no wiring.
Tooltip_OffGridTransformer: Carries the controller's power across town. Run a cable to the controller or to another transformer. While the system has power it lights everything around it, as far as the controller reaches, and it can wire up a building.
Tooltip_OffGridWallBank: A three-cell box that bolts to a wall. Half the storage of the rack, none of the footprint.
Tooltip_OffGridWallCrate: Two batteries on a plank shelf. Takes no floor space and not much else either.
Tooltip_OffGridWallSealed: Four sealed cells in a wall cabinet. The tidy way to fill a battery room.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkBarrelMixed: It holds something besides gasoline. Empty it first.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkBarrelTaken: This barrel already feeds a generator.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkConvert: Makes it a backup for an Off-Grid controller: run a cable from it to one and the controller starts and stops it. If Off-Grid is removed from this save, this generator is removed with it. Convert it to a normal generator first.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkFull: This controller already has four generators.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkHere: There is already a backup generator here.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkMaster: Starts a generator when the batteries run low, and stops it when they are nearly full or the sun has taken over.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkModded: This generator model can't be converted.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNoBarrel: No barrel of gasoline within 5 tiles. Put one nearby and fill it with gasoline.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkNoLink: Not connected to a controller. Run a cable from it to one.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkServerOff: Backup generators are switched off on this server.
Tooltip_OffGrid_BkSkill: Needs Electrical 3, or to have read Magazine: How to Use Generators.
Tooltip_OffGrid_CellEmpty: Empty bay. Drag a car battery here.
Tooltip_OffGrid_ChooseBuildings: Click a building or a player-built structure to add it or take it away. Anything this part reaches can be chosen.
Tooltip_OffGrid_Coverage: Coverage on your current floor. Green: supplying power. Amber: no power. Lights and appliances in reach glow green when switched on, white when switched off. Press Esc to hide.
Tooltip_OffGrid_NeedRagWater: You need a rag and some water.
Tooltip_OffGrid_Painted: Painted with the Brush Tool: not a working controller.
Tooltip_OffGrid_TooHeavy: Too heavy for what you are carrying.
Tooltip_OffGrid_UnwireBuildings: Stops powering the buildings this part wired. Its own reach stays.
Tooltip_OffGrid_WireBuilding: Powers every floor of the building this stands in or next to, whenever the system has power. Power can reach a few tiles past its walls. Whatever runs in there draws on the batteries.
Tooltip_Recipe_OffGridSkyReading: Knowledge of reading the coming weather from the sky.
